bagPolicy.summary: Spectrum Center has introduced a new bag policy allowing only small clutches, wallets, and wristlets not exceeding 4in x 6in x 1.5in for all arena events and Hornets games.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: Nearly 30,000 off-street parking spaces are available within a 15-minute walk of Spectrum Center. Guests can use SpotHero to find and reserve parking at various lots around the venue, with options for tailgating and oversized vehicles.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in Spectrum Center's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: Hugo’s Hive Menu offers fan-favorite concessions at $2 each, including hot dogs, pretzel bites, popcorn, bottled water, and soda. This initiative aims to provide affordable food options during Hornets games.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Sensory kits are available for check out at the Guest Experience booths located outside sections 102 and 208. To purchase wheelchair-accessible and companion seating, please call (704) 688-8128.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Re-entry to Spectrum Center is not permitted during any event.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: For select non-Hornets events, an artist will call may be available at the Box Office. On non-event days, the Box Office is open every Friday from 10 a.m. – 2 p.m. for walk up sales.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: For ticket holders who enter through the Bank of America 5^{th} Street Executive Entrance, there are elevators to the Event Level, Founders Level and Suite Level. Media members should enter through the Rick Bonnell Media & Employee Entrance, located on the 5^{th} Street side of Spectrum Center.
